---
name: Bug report
about: Report unexpected behavior in an SDK, API, worker or Studio release.
---

## What happened?

Describe the observed and expected behavior. Include the platform version, deployment mode and component.

## Reproduction

Give the smallest synthetic definition, input and sequence of actions that reproduces the problem. Include the relevant HTTP status or terminal run status. Remove credentials and customer information.

For a security vulnerability, follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
